pool.text: The king launched a military invasion of the Ngoenyang Kingdom of the Tai Yuan.
Fa Ngum founded the kingdom of Lan Xang, making the location an administrative city.
King Setthathirath officially established the location as the capital of Lan Xang.
Settha Palace Hotel was established in the city.
Vietnamese migration encouragement resulted in a majority Vietnamese population.
French paratroopers arrived and reoccupied the city.
Buddha Park was built by Luang Pu Bunleua Sulilat.
Kong Le seized the capital and insisted on a new prime minister.
Pathet Lao troops moved towards the city as Americans began evacuating.
A contingent of Pathet Lao women symbolically liberated the city.
The Laotian Civil War was officially declared over when the monarchy fell.
A metre gauge railway link over the first bridge was formally inaugurated.
Vientiane Rescue, a volunteer-run rescue service, was established.
The stock exchange opened with two listed company stocks with South Korean cooperation.
The Alliance Clinic opened near the airport with Thai hospital connections.
The railway line was officially opened.
Vientiane constructed its first bus rapid transit service.
The government announced that the city economy grew over five years.
The economy continued to grow from foreign investment in private health and electric vehicles.
The government announced an initiative to accrue investments to drive economic growth.
